description:
## Test-first scope
Extend :conversation with request %{action: :canonical_message, transcript_id: UUID, message_id: UUID}. Forward trusted event.actor and require confidentiality for this operation without altering existing operations. Use ExecutionActor.validate and People.get_active_literal_person; never trust requester IDs/teams from request or transport actor.id. Add thin Conversations entry point and Engine.Events helper targeting existing :conversation, not generic invoke.
Extract read gate from TranscriptHistory.list/3; reuse scope/parent/resource checks and Permissions.can? plus sanitized projection. Exact UUID lookup through TranscriptMessage, independent of recent history limits/provider IDs. Return {:ok, sanitized_message} with verified placement IDs and bounded attachment descriptors; exclude runtime handles/bytes/private execution state. Sanitize denial/not-found/invalid-request errors; keep infrastructure unavailability distinguishable. No Channels callbacks, hydration, permission writes or IO in the read. Preserve list/3 errors and trusted runtime-denial coordinates.
## Modules
TranscriptHistory, Conversations, Engine.Api, Engine.Events.
## Tests
Existing transcript_history_test.exs plus canonical_message_read_test.exs if separate suite clarifies boundary: allowed second person; inactive/malformed actor; missing/wrong placement; old message outside history window; same permission decision as listing; response sanitation; confidential/actor forwarding; existing conversation operations unchanged. Engine must not inspect or compare attachment locator fields.

Planning only: leave open; implementation has not started. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/action-reuse.md and relevant Engine/Channels/materialization guides. Write tests before implementation; reuse existing helpers rather than duplicate permission, projection or source-validation logic. No migration, new tool, attachment ACL, provider membership query, generic invoke, or attachment-specific Engine event.
title: Reuse transcript authorization for canonical-message reads
